description.en: Portfolio of Farrel Muhammad Zaki, Software Engineer (backend, frontend, full-stack). Software Engineering student at IPB University, Hackathon IFEST 2026 finalist.

intro.id: Saya Farrel, mahasiswa Software Engineering di IPB University. Saya membangun perangkat lunak web dan mobile, dari API dan basis data sampai antarmuka yang dipakai orang.
intro.en: I'm Farrel, a Software Engineering student at IPB University. I build web and mobile software, from APIs and databases to the interfaces people use.

intro.id: Proyek dari kompetisi, perkuliahan, dan klien, di bidang kesehatan, aksesibilitas, reservasi, pendidikan, dan bisnis.
intro.en: Projects from competitions, coursework and clients, across health, accessibility, reservations, education and business.

statement.id: Saya merancang dan membangun perangkat lunak dari basis data sampai layar: API yang konsisten, antarmuka yang mudah dipakai, dan sistem yang benar-benar digunakan.
statement.en: I design and build software from the database to the screen: consistent APIs, interfaces that are easy to use, and systems people actually rely on.

intro.id: Sertifikat dari hackathon, kompetisi ilmiah, dan organisasi kampus.
intro.en: Certificates from hackathons, research competitions and campus organisations.

intro.id: Terbuka untuk magang, proyek lepas, dan kolaborasi. Kirim pesan, saya akan membalas secepatnya.
intro.en: Open to internships, freelance projects and collaborations. Send a message and I’ll reply as soon as I can.
